definition: a person who fights for women's rights
description: On a wide city street full of marchers, a young woman with braids, a denim jacket and a purple bandana sits on a friend's shoulders and punches the air with a purple scarf tied to her fist. She shouts at first, then keeps her fist raised with a calm, proud face while the friend below her starts to smile. Her white T-shirt shows a big purple female symbol. Around her a crowd of women in purple T-shirts raise their fists and hold cardboard signs with the same symbol, and purple smoke drifts.
